extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Introduction to the Cold War
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Definition of Cold War, geopolitical rivalry between US and USSR, capitalist Western Bloc vs communist Eastern Bloc, timeframe (post-WWII to 1991), proxy wars, ideological and economic influence, arms race, Space Race, espionage, propaganda, embargoes, sports diplomacy.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Origins and Early Containment (1945-1953)
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Post-WWII satellite governments in Eastern Europe and North Korea, Iron Curtain, USSR nuclear weapon test (1949), Truman Doctrine (1947), Marshall Plan (1948), NATO (1949), Warsaw Pact (1955), Berlin Blockade (1948-1949), Korean War (1950-1953), George F. Kennan's Long Telegram, Winston Churchill's Fulton Speech, Turkish Straits crisis, Novikov telegram, James F. Byrnes' speech, Baruch Plan, Greek civil war, Yalta Agreement, National Security Act of 1947 (CIA, DoD, NSC), Molotov Plan, Czechoslovak coup d'etat (1948), London Six-Power Conference, Federal Republic of Germany vs German Democratic Republic, Point Four Program.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Cold War Espionage and Intelligence
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: KGB, CIA, atomic spies and the Manhattan Project, HUMINT, signals intelligence, Venona project, Kim Philby, Bill Weisband, debriefing defectors, active measures, disinformation, forgeries, spy wars between USSR and PRC.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Berlin Blockade and German Division
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Bizone and Trizone, Deutsche Mark currency, Berlin Blockade (1948-1949), Berlin airlift, Operation Vittles (Gail Halvorsen), Berlin municipal elections (1948), division of Berlin into sectors, Stalin's proposal for unified neutral Germany (1952).

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Rise of NATO and Propaganda Efforts
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: North Atlantic Treaty (1949), Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty, George F. Kennan, John Foster Dulles, CIA-funded intellectual projects, Crusade for Freedom, radio jamming by Soviet authorities.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Asian Conflict and the Korean War
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Chinese Civil War (Mao Zedong vs Chiang Kai-shek), People's Republic of China (1949), KMT in Taiwan, NSC 68, Paul Nitze, 'Pactomania' (ANZUS, SEATO), Korean War (1950-1953), Kim Il Sung, UN intervention, 38th Parallel, Inchon landing, rollback strategy, General Douglas MacArthur, Korean Armistice Agreement (1953).

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Nuclear Escalation and the 'New Look' (1953-1962)
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Dwight D. Eisenhower, Joseph Stalin's death, Nikita Khrushchev, de-Stalinization, 'We will bury you' declaration, John Foster Dulles' 'New Look' strategy, massive retaliation, Suez Crisis (1956), U-2 spy plane scandal, flexible response strategy (John F. Kennedy), ICBMs, B-52 bombers, Polaris submarines, fallout shelters.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Soviet Control in Eastern Europe
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Warsaw Pact (1955), Hungarian Revolution (1956), Matyas Rakosi, Imre Nagy, Khrushchev's 'peaceful coexistence', Rapacki Plan, Berlin Crisis (1958-1959), Khrushchev's ultimatum on Berlin.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Proxy Wars and Competition in the Third World
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Decolonization, CIA covert operations, Operation Ajax (Iran, Mohammad Mosaddegh, Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi), 1954 Guatemalan coup (Jacobo Arbenz, Carlos Castillo Armas), Indonesia (Sukarno, Permesta Movement, Allen Lawrence Pope), Congo Crisis (Patrice Lumumba, Joseph Kasa-Vubu, Mobutu Sese Seko), British Guiana (Cheddi Jagan), Malaya, Vietnam (Battle of Dien Bien Phu, 17th parallel division), Bandung Conference (1955), Non-Aligned Movement (1961).

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Sino-Soviet Split
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Breakdown of alliance after 1956, Mao Zedong vs Nikita Khrushchev, ideological propaganda war, rivalry for leadership of global communism, border conflict (1969), Nixon's rapprochement with China (1972), Joint Communique (1979).

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Space Race
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Sputnik 1 (1957), Sputnik crisis, ICBM development, Apollo Moon landings (1969), satellite reconnaissance, signals intelligence, Salyut programme (Almaz reconnaissance), international space treaties, Apollo-Soyuz orbital rendezvous.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Cuban Revolution and Missile Crisis
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Fidel Castro, Che Guevara, 26th of July Movement, Bay of Pigs invasion (Playa Giron/Playa Larga), Operation Mongoose, Cuban Missile Crisis (1962), naval blockade, removal of missiles from Cuba and Turkey, Khrushchev's ousting (1964).

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Berlin Wall and the 1961 Crisis
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Brain drain from East Germany, 1961 ultimatum, construction of the Berlin Wall (August 13, 1961).

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Vietnam War and its Aftermath
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Ngo Dinh Diem, Gulf of Tonkin incident (1964), Lyndon B. Johnson, Leonid Brezhnev's aid to North Vietnam, Tet Offensive (1968), US withdrawal, impact on US domestic politics (liberalism, civil rights, healthcare).

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Era of Detente (1962-1979)
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: General Suharto's rise in Indonesia (1965-1966), Cambodia invasion (1978), Pol Pot, 1973 oil crisis (OPEC), Leonid Brezhnev, Alexei Kosygin, Strategic Arms Limitation Talks (SALT), Nixon's visit to China, Willy Brandt's Ostpolitik, Helsinki Accords (1975), Armand Hammer, Kissinger's realism, Jackson-Vanik Amendment.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Prague Spring and Invasion of Czechoslovakia
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Prague Spring (1968), Action Program reforms, Soviet Army invasion (August 20, 1968), mass emigration.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Nuclear Treaties and Outer Space Law
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty (1963), Starfish Prime test, Outer Space Treaty (1967).

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Renewal of Tensions (1979-1985)
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Saur Revolution (1978), Soviet invasion of Afghanistan (1979), mujahideen, Operation Storm-333, Babrak Karmal, Jimmy Carter's response (SALT II withdrawal, grain embargo, 1980 Olympics boycott), Ronald Reagan, Margaret Thatcher, 'Evil Empire' rhetoric, Reagan Doctrine, CIA support for counterinsurgencies.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Polish Solidarity Movement
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Pope John Paul II, Solidarity trade union, Wojciech Jaruzelski, martial law (1981), Reagan's economic sanctions.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Military-Industrial Complexes and the 'Second Cold War'
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Soviet economic stagnation, nomenklatura, T-72 vs M1 Abrams, Reagan's military buildup (B-1 Lancer, LGM-118 Peacekeeper, Strategic Defense Initiative/Star Wars), RSD-10 Pioneer vs MGM-31 Pershing, KAL Flight 007 (1983), 1983 Soviet nuclear false alarm (Stanislav Petrov), Able Archer 83, Reagan's interventions (Grenada, Libya, Lebanon, Contras in Nicaragua, Guatemala).

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Gorbachev's Reforms and the End of the Cold War
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Mikhail Gorbachev, perestroika (restructuring), glasnost (openness), Geneva Summit (1985), Reykjavik Summit (1986), INF Treaty (1987), Moscow Summit (1988), Governors Island Summit (1988), withdrawal from Afghanistan (1989), Malta Summit (1989), Treaty on the Final Settlement with Respect to Germany, German reunification, START I treaty.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: The Collapse of the Eastern Bloc and USSR
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Revolutions of 1989, Pan-European Picnic, fall of the Berlin Wall (November 1989), collapse of communist regimes in Poland, Hungary, Czechoslovakia, Bulgaria, Romania, Boris Yeltsin, 1990 secession laws, Lithuania (Bloody Sunday), Latvia (The Barricades), August Coup (1991), dissolution of the USSR (December 25, 1991), emergence of 15 independent states, Russian Federation as successor state.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Post-Cold War Aftermath and Decommunization
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Russia's economic recession, lustration, decommunization in East Germany, Russia (renaming cities), Ukraine (outlawing communist symbols, removal of monuments), collapse of Yugoslavia (Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnian War, ethnic cleansing, NATO intervention Operation Deliberate Force and Operation Allied Force), unipolar world, neoliberal capitalism.

extracted_topics_and_scope.title: Historiography of the Cold War
extracted_topics_and_scope.focus: Orthodox accounts, Revisionism, Post-revisionism, debates on responsibility for the conflict's origins.
